banner.disabledDescription: Enable the Remote access module from the Extensions page to configure providers and external URLs.

about.title: Access URLs
about.description: Internal and external origins this installation is reachable at. Leave the internal URL empty to derive it from the network; set the external URL only for a hand-built reverse proxy or DDNS host. Enable or disable the module itself from the Extensions page.

proxyTrust.title: Proxy trust
proxyTrust.description: Forwarded client addresses are honoured only when the request comes from one of the trusted proxies listed here. Providers such as Tailscale Serve add their own proxy automatically.

internalUrl.title: Internal URL
internalUrl.description: Absolute origin override for the internal URL. Leave empty to derive it automatically.
internalUrl.invalid: Must be a normalized absolute HTTP(S) origin without a path, credentials, query, or fragment.

externalUrl.title: External URL
externalUrl.description: Manually configured external origin, e.g. behind a hand-built reverse proxy or DDNS host.
externalUrl.invalid: Must be a normalized absolute HTTP(S) origin without a path, credentials, query, or fragment.

trustForwardedHeaders.title: Trust forwarded headers
trustForwardedHeaders.description: Trust X-Forwarded-For, X-Real-IP and CF-Connecting-IP from the trusted proxies listed below.

trustedProxies.title: Trusted proxies
trustedProxies.placeholder: Add an IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR range and press enter
trustedProxies.description: IPv4/IPv6 addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to present forwarded-identity headers.
trustedProxies.invalid: Each entry must be a valid IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR range.
